name: What happens if issues are found during the final walkthrough?
description: Issues found during the walkthrough are added to a punch list, which the contractor must address before final payment.

mainEntity.name: What happens if issues are found during the final walkthrough?

acceptedAnswer.text: If issues are found during the final walkthrough, they are documented on the punch list. The contractor is then responsible for addressing these items within an agreed-upon timeframe. Final payment or a portion thereof is often withheld until all punch list items are satisfactorily completed. As a Process Clarity detail, Hometelligent Inc. works collaboratively with clients to ensure all identified deficiencies are resolved to their satisfaction, establishing clear timelines for corrections.
